review_method: Direct full-page visual reading of Claude integration QA03 pages 1-14. All fourteen QA04 rendered pages independently hash-identical to those reviewed images.

page_notes.1: Title, abstract, physics motivation and scope read; clean layout.
page_notes.2: Stored-coordinate geometry figure and caveats read; axes, captions and dimensions legible.
page_notes.3: Population definitions and architecture diagram read; physical stages and dependencies clear.
page_notes.4: Response, activity and centered-log target read; equations and units checked.
page_notes.5: Solver, layer allocation, counts, graph and support sampling read; physical limits explicit.
page_notes.6: Channel energy, budget closure and teacher-forced training read; no incident-energy conservation claim.
page_notes.7: Checkpoint choice, observables, deterministic bound and paired intervals read; controls disclosed.
page_notes.8: Primary results table and energy profiles read; ratios and section compensation clear.
page_notes.9: Normalized paired interval, fixed-region energy and illustrative support figure read; count definitions accurate.
page_notes.10: Classifier and numerical failures, activity null and causal limits read.
page_notes.11: Limitations, timing scope, conclusion, availability and acknowledgments read; no affiliation label.
page_notes.12: AI declaration, provenance and calibration table read; scientific responsibility and runtime limits explicit.
page_notes.13: Energy-bin means/widths, classifier seeds and evaluator details read; tables legible.
page_notes.14: Classifier partition caveat and all 25 references read; links, margins and typography clear.

scientific_scope: Document and numerical evidence review; not physics validation.
